output.arguments:
{"command": "mkdir -p /tmp/prep
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter
p='/app/documents/F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg'
im=Image.open(p).convert('L')
print('size', im.size, 'extrema', im.getextrema())
# variants
for name, func in [
    ('autocontrast', lambda x: ImageOps.autocontrast(x)),
    ('threshold', lambda x: x.point(lambda v: 255 if v>160 else 0)),
    ('threshold2', lambda x: x.point(lambda v: 255 if v>100 else 0)),
    ('upscale', lambda x: x.resize((x.width*2,x.height*2), Image.LANCZOS)),
    ('sharpen', lambda x: x.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)),
]:
    out=func(im)
    out.save('/tmp/prep/'+name+'.png')
    print(name, out.size, out.getextrema())
PY
for img in /tmp/prep/*.png; do echo "===== $(basename "$img") psm6 ====="; tesseract "$img" stdout --psm 6 2>/dev/null; done
echo '--- rotations psm6 ---'
for deg in 90 180 270; do python3 -c "from PIL import Image; im=Image.open('/app/documents/F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg'); im.rotate($deg, expand=True).save('/tmp/prep/rot$deg.png')"; echo "===== rot $deg ====="; tesseract "/tmp/prep/rot$deg.png" stdout --psm 6 2>/dev/null; done"}
